basics.name: Nazmus Sakib

basics.summary: CS graduate from CUET with a strong background in NLP research and full-stack software engineering. Published at NAACL 2025 and COLING 2025. Currently working as a Software Engineer at AsthaIT Inc.

work.name: AsthaIT Inc.
work.summary: Developing and maintaining Apex4u.com, a high-traffic e-commerce platform.
highlights: Developed and maintained Apex4u.com using ASP.NET Core Web API (backend) and Next.js (frontend), hosted on AWS EC2
Architected backend following Clean Architecture with SOLID principles and dependency injection
Designed real-time notification system using SignalR (WebSockets) — increased user engagement by 35%
Integrated AWS S3 as CDN and AWS SQS for decoupled message queuing in the POS subsystem
Implemented Redis caching layer, improving API response times by ~40%
Built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; containerized services with Docker
Integrated Google Analytics Data API for real-time traffic analytics in admin dashboard

work.name: Inument Solutions Limited
work.summary: Designed and built Taxinument, a RAG system for intelligent querying of financial and tax documents.
highlights: Implemented full data pipeline: PDF ingestion → text chunking → OpenAI embeddings → Qdrant vector store → semantic retrieval
Orchestrated multi-step LLM chains using LangChain with GPT-4; achieved 90%+ retrieval accuracy
Exposed as production REST API via FastAPI with async endpoints and Pydantic validation
Reduced query latency by 60% through caching and chunk optimization
